'''Scritchy''' was a pet [[rakling]] owned by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] during his retirement on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. A former [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]], Scritchy and the other raklings treated by Lokin were infected with a customized strain of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], making them sterile and relatively harmless. After being recruited into the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul in [[3631 BBY]], Lokin took Scritchy with him to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scritchy appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' after the completion of Eckard Lokin Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
